verdict.rationale: The Gmail REST API exposes a versioned endpoint path (gmail/v1), so versioning is at least implied by the product's own reference docs. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, versioning guarantees, or sunset timelines. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning/compatibility guarantees, migration or sunset notice process, independent corroboration of API stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Gmail API is a RESTful API that lets you access Gmail mailboxes and send mail.
